facts.text: Rufio, look at the table. You have to believe the food is there before you taste it.
facts.why: Peter Banning does not say this in the film. The imaginary feast is real in the film but this line is not his, and the quote page I opened has other lines.
facts.fix: Rufio, look at the table. The food is there if you believe it.
